arStrings.szText: Debilitating Roar

Shapeshift into a Werebear and bellow a mighty roar reducing Nearby enemies' damage dealt by {c_number}[{SF_2} * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_0|1|]{/c} seconds.
Defensive Skill: Bellow with ferocity, reducing the damage of enemies.
{icon:bullet,1.2} Duration {icon:arrow,1.2} {c_number}[SF_0|1|] seconds{/c}
All {c_important}Debilitating Roar's{/c} effects and durations are increased by {c_number}[SF_19 * 100|%|]{/c}.
Booming Roar
{c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} no longer has a Cooldown but costs {c_resource}[SF_20]{/c} Spirit to cast instead.
Survival Instincts
{c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} immediately grants {c_number}[SF_17]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} and an additional {c_number}[SF_18]{/c} stack every second for the duration.
Roar of Resolve

Increase the duration of {c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} by {if:Mod.UpgradeA}{c_number}[SF_24|1|]{/c} seconds or {c_number}[SF_24 + SF_25|1|]{/c} seconds{else}{c_number}[SF_24]{/c} second or {c_number}[SF_24 + SF_25]{/c} seconds{/if} if you are {c_important}{u}Fortified{/u}{/c}.
Increased Duration
{c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} Slows enemies by {c_number}[SF_23 * 100|%|]{/c} for the duration.
Slow
{c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} grants you and your allies {c_number}[SF_22*100|%|]{/c} bonus Maximum Life for the duration.
Maximum Life
Reduce the Cooldown of {c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} by {c_number}[SF_26]{/c} seconds.
Cooldown
{c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} reduces Nearby enemies' damage dealt by an additional {c_number}[SF_8 * 100|%|]{/c}.
